evidence.title: GitHub - charlie947/voiceprint: Turn your own spoken words into a finished article.

name: voiceprint
summary: Agent skill that turns your own spoken transcript into a finished article, keeping your sentences.
description: A skill plus setup script: record 11-13 minutes of speech per 1,500 words, drop the raw transcript into voices/ and run /voiceprint; the agent does research, structure, headings and checking while cutting your literal sentences together. Ships trace.py, which fails the draft below 85% of your own wording, a browser PROMPT.md path for ChatGPT and Gemini, and states its limits on detector verdicts.
